milestones.label: Application period opens for the Class of 2028-2029 (global applicants)
milestones.source_text: The official Schwarzman Scholars admissions page lists April 2027 as the start of the application period for the class starting in August 2028, for applicants from outside China.

milestones.label: Application deadline for global applicants (month only: September 2027; day not published)
milestones.source_text: The official page gives only the closing month, September 2027, for global applicants. No day is stated.

milestones.label: Selection cycle and interviews (global applicants)
milestones.source_text: The official page names October to November 2027 as the selection cycle for global applicants and says a selected number of candidates are interviewed in late October and early November.

milestones.label: Application period for applicants with Chinese citizenship (Mainland, Hong Kong, Macau, Taiwan)
milestones.source_text: The official page gives a separate, earlier window of March to May 2027 for applicants with Chinese citizenship, with selection in June to July 2027.
